meta.name: Zakhmi 720p
meta.description: Zakhmi is the story of Saira Mallik who sets out on a mission to avenge her husband's murder, only to find out that there are bigger conspiracies involved. She soon realises that her battle is against none other than the people she thought were her own.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Saira Mallik wakes up in a container on the docks of Hong Kong, beaten with no clue on how she reached there. As she makes her way to Macau, we see flashes of what happened in Saira’s life in past.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Saira swears revenge on the people who destroyed her and makes her way to a Casino in Macau where she finds her ticket back to Mumbai.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Saira, now going by the name of Anamika, begins to put her plan for revenge into action. Mohit and Raisingh realise that Anamika is hiding something.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Raisingh offers to help Anamika. When things start to go south, Mohit comes to her rescue. MK meets with Amrita and tells her that they had lost Anamika.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Mohit and Anamika join hands and begin to dig deeper into Rohan’s murder. Anamika confronts Amrita.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Raisingh leads Anamika and Mohit on a wild goose chase. MK holds Anamika hostage, while Mohit looks for her. Anamika manages to turn the tables on her captors.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Anamika tells Rohan and Raisingh that she would take care of Anamika. Mohit and Anamika try to dig deeper into Sinhal Industries. Anamika and Mohit get closer.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Anamika gets close to Gabriel so that she can get a step closer to killing Rohan and Raisingh. However Roha turns the tables on them.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The arms deal goes south and Anamika and Mohit escape from there. They stumble upon a lead and Anamika realises that she has to revisit her past to find answers.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Anamika confronts Amrita. Mohit and Anamika find a way to corner Amrita. Amrita attacks Anamika, leaving her at death’s door.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Mohit and Anamika seek help from the police to get to Amrita. Rohan outsmarts the cops. Mohit and Anamika manage to level the playing field.
